rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: This server provides tools for SMB/CIFS network share enumeration and interaction through the smbmap framework. It supports connecting to SMB hosts, listing shares, browsing and transferring files, executing commands on remote systems, and checking administrative privileges. Security professionals can use it to audit network file share configurations and access controls.
